messages.content: I want the violation badge for project ID badae.

function.name: badge_api_BadgeApi_get_project_policy_violations_badge
function.description: Generates a badge image representing the policy violations status of a specified project. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

uuid.description: The unique identifier of the project for which the policy violations badge is to be generated.

format.description: The image format of the badge to be returned.

style.description: The style of the badge to be returned.

function.name: BadgeApi_get_project_policy_violations_badge1
function.description: Retrieves a badge indicating the policy violations status for a specified project and version. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The unique name identifier of the project for which the policy violations badge is requested.

version.description: The version identifier of the project for which the policy violations badge is requested.

function.name: violation_api_ViolationApi_get_violations_by_project
function.description: Retrieves a list of all policy violations associated with a given project ID. It can be configured to include suppressed violations as well. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

uuid.description: The unique identifier of the project for which violations are being queried.

suppressed.description: Determines whether suppressed violations should be included in the results. Suppressed violations are those that have been flagged as not requiring immediate action.

message.reasoning:
The user wants the violation badge for project ID "badae". We need to call the appropriate function. Which function? There are two badge functions:

- badge_api_BadgeApi_get_project_policy_violations_badge takes uuid and optional format/style.

- BadgeApi_get_project_policy_violations_badge1 takes name and version.

User gave project ID "badae". That looks like a UUID or maybe a name? It's ambiguous. But likely it's a UUID. So we use badge_api_BadgeApi_get_project_policy_violations_badge with uuid="badae".

We need to decide format and style. Default is svg and flat. We can just use defaults. So call badge_api_BadgeApi_get_project_policy_violations_badge with uuid="badae".
